tools.name: api_reset_policy
tools.description: Reset execution policy to safe dry-run, deny-by-default settings.

tools.name: api_load_open_api
tools.description: Load an OpenAPI/Swagger definition from a URL or local file. Parses it, builds semantic operation/schema/security evidence and replaces the in-memory vector index atomically.

tools.name: api_clear_auth
tools.description: Clear any configured API authentication from this process.

tools.name: api_set_bearer_token
tools.description: Set a Bearer token in memory for API requests made by this MCP process.

tools.name: api_call_operation
tools.description: Build or execute an OpenAPI operation by operationId. The current policy controls methods, target URLs, network access and dry-run/live behaviour.

tools.name: api_ask_contract
tools.description: Ask Azure AI a grounded question about the loaded API using only retrieved OpenAPI evidence.

tools.name: api_get_policy
tools.description: Get the current in-memory execution policy.

tools.name: api_search_contract
tools.description: Search the loaded OpenAPI contract semantically and return the most relevant operation/schema/security evidence without calling the chat model.

tools.name: api_set_policy
tools.description: Update the in-memory execution policy. Disabled unless the MCP process was started with policy mutation explicitly enabled.

tools.name: api_describe_operation
tools.description: Describe an OpenAPI operation (method, path, params, request body, responses, security) by operationId.

tools.name: api_generate_test_plan
tools.description: Generate a deterministic, constraint-driven API test plan for an operationId using the OpenAPI contract. Includes parameters, schema bounds and concrete edge-case inputs.

tools.name: api_list_operations
tools.description: List operations in the loaded OpenAPI document with operation ID, method, path and summary.

tools.name: api_set_base_url
tools.description: Set the base URL used for executing API requests. Overrides servers[] in the OpenAPI spec for this process only.
